[1], [2] Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press; Washington, DC: National Gallery of Art; Abiquiu, NM: The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, 1999), p. 142, cat. 262.

remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Verso inscription 2 dates 1918 and indicates no. 45 in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. Completed after June move to New York. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
